purpose.domain_detail: Italian order management and warehouse commitment recalculation system; recalculates committed quantities (impegnato) from unfulfilled orders and uninvoiced credit notes for specific articles passed via linkage
purpose.summary: This program recalculates warehouse commitment quantities (impegnato) for specific articles passed in the linkage section. It zeroes out existing commitment records in PROGMAG, then recomputes from master orders (MTORDINI/MRORDINI) and unfulfilled/uninvoiced orders (TORDINI/RORDINI). It is called exclusively from GORDCVAR when a flag in CBLCONFI is set to 'S'.

notable_features: DECLARATIVES section with USE AFTER ERROR for file locking
LINKAGE SECTION with array of articles passed from caller
Environment variable check via ACCEPT FROM ENVIRONMENT
verdict.notes: The pipe-character (|) used as inline comment delimiter is a GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL extension not standard COBOL; this strongly suggests GnuCOBOL dialect. The program is part of a larger Italian ERP system for order/warehouse management. LUBEXX-prefixed comment lines suggest version-specific annotations. The .sl and .fd copy file extensions are consistent with GnuCOBOL SELECT/FD copybook conventions.
